key_deadlines.item_title: Requirements for Additional Traceability Records for Certain Foods; Proposed Exemption for Cottage Cheese Regulated by the National Conference on Interstate Milk Shipments Grade “A” Pasteurized Milk Ordinance

items.title: Requirements for Additional Traceability Records for Certain Foods; Proposed Exemption for Cottage Cheese Regulated by the National Conference on Interstate Milk Shipments Grade “A” Pasteurized Milk Ordinance

enrichments.summary: The FDA has issued a proposed rule to exempt cottage cheese from the Food Traceability Rule (FSMA 204) recordkeeping requirements, provided it is regulated under the National Conference on Interstate Milk Shipments Grade “A” Pasteurized Milk Ordinance.
key_entities: National Conference on Interstate Milk Shipments
